attempts.exactPrompt:

Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Loris Haleth: 22-year-old woman, 173 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-3-light-medium. Do not copy the reference's person, braid, clothes, pose, palette, progression, identity, body, hair, garments, ornaments, or markings.

RESERVE ACTIVATION: This is a fresh base summon, not an edit or regeneration of any existing hero. Create the new identity described above using only the authorized rendering-style reference. Honor the complete activated physical manifest and reserve character kernel; no failed hero or failed candidate is a visual source.

findings.observation: Original-resolution inspection shows exactly one adult woman with one coherent body and no duplicated anatomy.
The full head and hair, both hands including the upturned palm, both fitted shoes, split longcoat hems, and medicine pouch remain inside generous margins.

Visible brush planes and restrained illustrative texture across skin, hair, cloth, and parchment staging establish a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing rather than photography, plastic 3D, or cel anime.

The slight long-limbed body, compact face, high cheekbones, soft-lidded eyes, short rounded nose, wide mouth, copper locs, ochre-cream tailored split longcoat, fitted shoes, broad stance, upturned palm, and medicine pouch read clearly, but the required one small nape tattoo appears on the side neck; facial freckling contradicts no added facial mark, and braid cuffs plus dangling belt ornaments exceed density 1.
The wide mouth is closed and unsmiling; softly lidded eyes and level bearing remain calm without theatrical acting.

The subject remains an ordinary grounded mortal in cloth clothing with a small empty pouch and no weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, affinity cue, glow, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, or text.

The compact face and longcoat cut differ, but the shaved-side, long braid mass draped over one shoulder with decorative cuffs reproduces the reference’s dominant hair silhouette and ornament construction too closely for the strict non-transfer gate.
